questions.question: Lowland regions of Kerala.
questions.solution_html:
• The lowland region of Kerala, locally known as Theeradesham (coastal region), is the
  • narrow strip of land along the Arabian Sea. It extends alo ng the western side of the state
  • and is generally situated at an elevation of less than 7.5 metres above sea level.

questions.question: Lateritization.
questions.solution_html:
• Lateritization is the process of soil formation in hot and humid tropical regions through
  • intense leaching of silica and other soluble minera ls. It leads to the accumulation of iron
  • and aluminium oxides in the soil, resulting in the formation of laterite soil. (Definition- 2
  • marks).
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Supracrustal rocks.
questions.solution_html:
• Supracrustal rocks are oldest rocks formed from sediments or volcanic materials deposited
  • on the Earth's crust and later subjected to processes such as metamorphism. They
  • commonly include metamorphosed sedimentary and volcanic rocks. (Definition- 2
  • marks).
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Gniess.
questions.solution_html:
• Gneiss is a coarse-grained metamorphic rock formed under high temperature and pressure.
  • It is characterised by alternating bands of light -coloured minerals, such as qu artz and
  • feldspar, and dark-coloured minerals, such as mica or amphibole. (Definition(2 marks)).

questions.question: Basic intrusive rock.
questions.solution_html:
• Basic intrusive rocks are dark -coloured igneous rocks formed by the slow cooling and
  • solidification of magma beneath the Earth's surface. In Kerala, dolerite and gabbro are
  • examples of basic intrusive rocks. (Definition(1 mark); Location in Kerala(1 mark)).

questions.question: Non-metallic mineral resources of Kerala.
questions.solution_html:
• The major non -metallic mineral resources of Kerala include china clay (kaolin), silica sand
  • limestone, graphite, bauxite and mineral sands containing ilmenite, rutile and monazite. (List
  • of 6 (2 marks)).
